newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says seeks up to 35,000 T vegetable oils.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says seeks up to 35,000 T vegetable oils.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said on Sunday it wanted to buy up to 35,000 tonnes of vegetable oils for delivery in first half April.
The oils are in two lots:
-- 20,000 to 25,000 tonnes, plus or minus five percent, of raw sunflower oil, semi-refined cottonseed oil and/or U.S. cottonseed oil of 162 degrees.
-- 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes, plus or minus five percent, of degummed soy oil, any origin.
The deadline for bids is noon (1000 GMT) on March 5.
